alt: An illuminated leaf with a kneeling armoured man, a woman holding a shield, floral borders and armorial corners, and red lettering on gold scrolls above and below the scene.
rights: Facsimile image: CC0, verified in Getty’s IIIF manifest. Getty catalogue prose has a separate CC BY 4.0 notice; teaching prose here is original editorial work.

prompt: Begin with the lower scroll. Record what letter forms and separators you see before supplying word spaces. Compare the upper scroll, and mark any joined letters explicitly. Leave the full blazon and the identity of later paint unresolved unless another source supports them.
